description: This Java class models an immutable representation of a configuration field within a larger configuration system. It handles parsing, size calculation, and code generation (for TunerStudio and Java fields) related to configuration parameters, including handling arrays, bit fields, and custom types.

classes.name: ConfigField
classes.description: Represents a single configuration parameter with parsing, size calculation, and code generation methods.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a line of input into a ConfigField object using regex matching.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the field, considering bit fields and arrays.

methods.name: getHeaderText
methods.description: Generates C header code snippet for the configuration field.

methods.name: writeTunerStudio
methods.description: Generates TunerStudio configuration lines and updates the position counter.

methods.name: writeJavaFields
methods.description: Generates Java code for representing the configuration field.
